# Lenis 1.3.1

Official browser bundle and stylesheet, kept local for this buildless site.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.3.1/
Project: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/tree/v1.3.1
License: MIT; see LICENSE in this directory.

The version, interpolation (0.1), and wheel multiplier (1) match the inspected
Le Pain Quotidien reference. Initialization lives in script.js. Touch scrolling
remains native, and reduced motion disables smoothing.
